notes.title: Steam Next Fest: Celebration Livestream Part 2.
notes.content:
Void's Ballad SECOND LIVESTREAM on October 7th!

Come enjoy Void's Ballad, watch people play the demo and chat with the developers! Take a look at a preview of the game, or just ask any question!

We'll be more than happy to answer to anyone of you and we'll love to talk and read all your opinions, critiques, theories and more about the game!

Isn't a livestream enough?

Well well well, the demo is available for anyone to play freely!
Go check out Void's Ballad before watching the live, then come join us and let us know more about your experience and give us any opinion about it!

Did you already play the game?

Perfect!
We're here to discuss about it!
Do you have any question about it? Any doubt? Or just some curiosities? The developers will love to hear them all!

Afterall, we all want you to have the best experience out of it!

So, even if you have nothing to ask, or you didn't even play the game, just sit here, grab some snacks, open up the livestream and enjoy some chit chat! Maybe you'll just discover a new game you like or you'll just have a great time with new people!

There's something more...
A special annoucement is going to be there, during the second livestream!
